propositions: Documentation batch F08 through F20 requires completing approved repository recommendations with correct README workflow facts, operation-certificate guidance, and configuration contracts.
F20 requires updating the GitHub About description to lead with enforced plan review and signed completion verification using gh repo edit and exact readback verification.
MCP summary generation and transition registrar wording must be corrected with configuration contract regeneration through three bounded F19 children.
Generated artifacts must be changed only through canonical sources with later children rebased and regenerated from current origin/main before gates.
Each repository child must land as independently reviewable Gerrit change with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and unresolved-comment gates before merge.
GitHub metadata child F20 must pass plan review and exact readback verification before close while leaving repository files, topics, and homepage unchanged.
